text.en:
Reconstitution. The Power Development Council is hereby reconstituted as follows:
1. Secretary Department of Public Works, Transportation and Communications
2. Chairman Energy Development Board or his duly designated representative.
Vice Chairman
3. Deputy Director-General for Planning & Policy National Economic and Development Authority
4. Undersecretary Department of Industry
5. Undersecretary Department of Finance
6. General Manager National Power Corporation

7. Administrator National Electrification Administration
The Chairman of the Board of Power and Waterworks is hereby enjoined to participate in the meetings and
deliberations of the Council and render such necessary assistance in matters involving the jurisdiction and
responsibilities of the Board.

Relationships with Other Agencies. All acts and decisions of the Council in the exercise of its
powers and functions under this Decree shall be final and conclusive, unless otherwise specifically directed by
the President. The Council shall have supervisory powers on policy matters over other government agencies
concerned with electric power. It shall coordinate with the proper agencies with regard to financial matters,
infrastructure and other sectoral requirements of the overall development program.
The Energy Development Board shall coordinate, review and approve plans and programs of the Council in
accordance with Presidential Decree No. 910.

Officials and Employees of the Council. The Council shall be assisted by an Executive Secretary
appointed by the Council. Any provision of law to the contrary notwithstanding, the Council shall appoint the
officers and employees of the Council, fix their compensation, allowances and benefits, their work hours and
such other conditions of employment as it may deem proper, grant them leaves of absence under such
regulations as it may promulgate, discipline and/or remove them for cause, and establish and maintain a
recruitment and merit system.

Government Assistance. In the performance of its functions, the Council is empowered to direct
call upon any government agency, office or instrumentality for such assistance in personnel or resources, as
may be necessary to attain the objectives of this Decree.

Appropriations. The sum of Five Hundred Thousand Pesos (P500,000.00) out of any available
funds from the National Treasury is hereby appropriated and authorized to be released for the organization of
the Council and its initial operation during the period ending December 31, 1976. Henceforth, funds sufficient
to fully carry out the functions and objectives of the Council shall be appropriated every fiscal year and
includes as an item in the appropriations for the Energy Development Board as provided in Section 8 of P.D.

Repealing Clause. All previous orders and laws inconsistent with this Decree are hereby
repealed or modified accordingly.
Done in the City of Manila, this 17th day of June, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and seventy-six.
